name: 6606-eagledecode-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE draft head. The target is an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- same weights, same tokenizer, same 128256 vocab the draft head is trained against; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU, unsharded.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, rope_theta 500000, served float16. Draft: LlamaForCausalLMEagle, one decoder layer, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 -- one request in flight. Warmup the first 10%, bounded at 40 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts fixed at 1000 tokens and generations fixed at 1000 tokens -- stdev 0, min and max pinned to the same value. `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0` ride in `extras.body`, so every request generates its full 1000 tokens. Requests go to `/v1/completions`, not the chat route. 1000 + 1000 is a hard ceiling and not a round number: the draft head declares 2048 positions.
purpose: A single-user drafting-accelerated 8B writing assistant turning 1000-token briefs into 1000-token drafts, one request at a time, on one GPU.
launch:
# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct: same weights, same tokenizer, same 128256
# vocab. The Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's bfloat16: the draft head is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16
trust-remote-code: true
attention-backend: fa3

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

mem-fraction-static: 0.88
